import MilneLib.SymmetricPower.SymmetricPowerOpen
import MilneLib.SymmetricPower.RelativePowerGeometricallyIntegral
import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotientFunctionField

/-!
# Function fields of canonical symmetric quotients

If the relative power is integral, its canonical symmetric quotient is integral
and pullback induces a Galois, hence separable, extension of scheme function
fields. The finite quotient projection supplies affineness of the morphism;
neither the source nor the quotient scheme is required to be affine.

This proves the integral-relative-power case of the separability assertion in
Milne III.3.1. Geometric integrality and local finite type of the source over a
field supply the integrality hypothesis for every finite relative power.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry TopologicalSpace

namespace MilneLib

section IntegralPower

variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
  (V : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (n : ℕ)
  [(relativePower V n).left.IsSeparated] [CompactSpace (relativePower V n).left]
  (h : StableGroupAction.OrbitsInAffineOpen (permutationAutHomOverLeft V n))
  [IsIntegral (relativePower V n).left]

/-- The canonical symmetric quotient of an integral relative power is integral. -/
theorem symmetricPowerQuotient_isIntegral :
    IsIntegral (symmetricPowerQuotient V n h).left :=
  (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_isGeometricQuotient V n h).isIntegral_target

/-- Pullback along the canonical symmetric projection gives a Galois extension
of actual scheme function fields when the relative power is integral. -/
theorem symmetricPowerQuotient_functionField_isGalois
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (relativePower V n).hom] :
    letI := symmetricPowerQuotient_isIntegral V n h
    let q := (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection V n h).left
    letI : Surjective q := ⟨symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_surjective V n h⟩
    letI := (functionFieldMap q (genericPoint_eq_of_isDominant q)).hom.toAlgebra
    IsGalois (symmetricPowerQuotient V n h).left.functionField
      (relativePower V n).left.functionField := by
  letI := symmetricPowerQuotient_isIntegral V n h
  let q := (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection V n h).left
  letI : Surjective q := ⟨symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_surjective V n h⟩
  letI : IsFinite q := symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_isFinite V n h
  exact (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_isGeometricQuotient V n h).functionField_isGalois
    (genericPoint_eq_of_isDominant q)

/-- The canonical symmetric projection is separable on function fields when
its relative power is integral. -/
theorem symmetricPowerQuotient_functionField_isSeparable
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (relativePower V n).hom] :
    letI := symmetricPowerQuotient_isIntegral V n h
    let q := (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection V n h).left
    letI : Surjective q := ⟨symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_surjective V n h⟩
    letI := (functionFieldMap q (genericPoint_eq_of_isDominant q)).hom.toAlgebra
    Algebra.IsSeparable (symmetricPowerQuotient V n h).left.functionField
      (relativePower V n).left.functionField := by
  letI := symmetricPowerQuotient_isIntegral V n h
  let q := (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection V n h).left
  letI : Surjective q := ⟨symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_surjective V n h⟩
  letI := (functionFieldMap q (genericPoint_eq_of_isDominant q)).hom.toAlgebra
  letI := symmetricPowerQuotient_functionField_isGalois V n h
  exact IsGalois.to_isSeparable

end IntegralPower

/-- For a geometrically integral scheme locally of finite type over a field,
the canonical symmetric projection induces a Galois, hence separable,
extension of function fields. Integrality of the power is derived from the
source hypotheses. -/
theorem symmetricPowerQuotient_functionField_isGalois_of_geometricallyIntegral
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (V : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (n : ℕ)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral V.hom]
    [(relativePower V n).left.IsSeparated] [CompactSpace (relativePower V n).left]
    (h : StableGroupAction.OrbitsInAffineOpen (permutationAutHomOverLeft V n)) :
    letI := relativePower_isIntegral V n
    letI := symmetricPowerQuotient_isIntegral V n h
    let q := (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection V n h).left
    letI : Surjective q := ⟨symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_surjective V n h⟩
    letI := (functionFieldMap q (genericPoint_eq_of_isDominant q)).hom.toAlgebra
    IsGalois (symmetricPowerQuotient V n h).left.functionField
      (relativePower V n).left.functionField := by
  letI := relativePower_isIntegral V n
  letI := relativePower_locallyOfFiniteType V n
  exact symmetricPowerQuotient_functionField_isGalois V n h

/-- For a geometrically integral scheme locally of finite type over a field,
the canonical symmetric projection induces a separable extension of function
fields. -/
theorem symmetricPowerQuotient_functionField_isSeparable_of_geometricallyIntegral
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (V : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (n : ℕ)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral V.hom]
    [(relativePower V n).left.IsSeparated] [CompactSpace (relativePower V n).left]
    (h : StableGroupAction.OrbitsInAffineOpen (permutationAutHomOverLeft V n)) :
    letI := relativePower_isIntegral V n
    letI := symmetricPowerQuotient_isIntegral V n h
    let q := (symmetricPowerQuotientProjection V n h).left
    letI : Surjective q := ⟨symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_surjective V n h⟩
    letI := (functionFieldMap q (genericPoint_eq_of_isDominant q)).hom.toAlgebra
    Algebra.IsSeparable (symmetricPowerQuotient V n h).left.functionField
      (relativePower V n).left.functionField := by
  letI := relativePower_isIntegral V n
  letI := relativePower_locallyOfFiniteType V n
  exact symmetricPowerQuotient_functionField_isSeparable V n h

end MilneLib
